method: Pinned committed Git objects; exact script inventory and blob/hash custody; lexical references are candidates, not execution/dead-code proof. All non-script text is scanned for interpreter tokens; archives inspected without extraction.

cache.failure_cases: Unexpected workspace artifacts, incompatible source/destination, implicit overwrite, runtime link failure; restore replaced destinations on failure.
cache.outputs: Only eligible external dependency artifacts hardlinked into trusted same-host/same-filesystem/same-toolchain target; summary of linked/skipped entries and rollback.
cache.platform_scope: Same-host Unix hardlink acceleration only; not validation or cross-host cache acceptance.
cache.sequencing: Keep wrapper argument/output behavior; preserve every existing link-failure and replacement rollback case.

ci-policy.caller_switch: #1346 switches Ruby policy callers; #1348 switches Python policy/workflow callers.
ci-policy.failure_cases: Selected lane failure/skipped/missing; unselected success; failed path policy or contracts; malformed YAML; unauthorized events; seven deadline variants; unpinned actions.
ci-policy.outputs: Existing path-policy selection keys, string booleans, reason codes and GitHub output; aggregate ci/coverage exit outcome; YAML workflow/toolchain/action/deadline policy diagnostics.
ci-policy.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
ci-policy.sequencing: Native Ruby checks must continue consuming existing Python policy outputs until #1348 changes those callers atomically; six aggregation and seven deadline cases stay intact.

compatibility.failure_cases: Missing/tampered contracts, invalid lockset, incompatible public schema or source shape.
compatibility.outputs: Compatibility lockset identities and pass/fail results across all 29 existing compatibility cases.
compatibility.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
compatibility.sequencing: Replace all 29 cases before removing the Python suite; one Rust subprocess harness is not equivalent coverage.

coverage.caller_switch: #1348 owns coverage.py and nightly/workflow callers; #1349 owns CLI test commands invoked by coverage.
coverage.failure_cases: Duplicate/missing production owners/reports, unexpected measured source, invalid counts, zero or empty denominator, dirty inputs, insufficient thresholds.
coverage.outputs: Public LLVM JSON-derived per-file counts, owner mapping, report/provenance artifacts and threshold results: PR changed files >=80%; full aggregate >=90% and each file >=80%.
coverage.platform_scope: Ubuntu CI LLVM coverage; preserve local supported toolchain behavior. This is not Windows or provider qualification.
coverage.sequencing: Land #1348 with compatible existing test command interfaces; #1349 switches the coverage instrumentation harness list atomically when native CLI tests replace Python. Final interpreter-free claim waits for #1349.

distribution.caller_switch: #1349 owns package scripts, Rust distribution wrappers and transpiler workflow switches.
distribution.failure_cases: Manifest/digest/identity mismatch, extra/duplicate/missing archive member, non-file/path traversal, wrong modes/lengths, unsafe extraction, installed consumer failure.
distribution.outputs: Versioned Gödel and remote-validation archives/manifests/checksums; transpiler manifest schema adl.transpiler_demo.installed.v1 and member paths, hashes, bytes, 0755 executable/0644 data modes.
distribution.platform_scope: Preserve existing Linux CI installed consumers and platform-neutral archive rules; binaries remain platform-specific.
distribution.sequencing: Frozen archive bytes and version/pin contracts must remain intact unless an explicit versioned regeneration is required; inspect extracted installed behavior.

fixtures-scaffolds.caller_switch: #1351 owns fixtures/scaffolds and all consumer updates.
fixtures-scaffolds.failure_cases: Malformed JSON, missing scaffold paths or invalid fixture content; preserve intentional refusal results.
fixtures-scaffolds.outputs: Scaffold repository checks and aptitude-atlas fixture validation protocol/report shape remain equivalent for their actual consumer.
fixtures-scaffolds.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
fixtures-scaffolds.sequencing: If Python-as-input itself is required semantics, request an explicit exception before acceptance; default zero means replace fixture language and update the contract deliberately.

historical.caller_switch: #1347 owns caller and historical-source decisions; #1350 owns guard implementation.
historical.failure_cases: Missing preimage, unexpected deletion, protected evidence change, unresolved live caller.
historical.outputs: Original reports, receipts and evidence bytes remain unchanged; obsolete executable source can disappear only with a retrievable original blob/mode and reviewed successor overlay.
historical.platform_scope: Source/custody inspection is platform independent; no execution-platform acceptance inferred.
historical.sequencing: Keep existing guards during retirement. If an overlay needs new guard support, defer that batch until #1350; do not add a reverse dependency.

integrity.caller_switch: #1350 owns implementations and source_retirement/validator; #1347 supplies reviewed new overlays.
integrity.failure_cases: Tampered manifest, lost custody, changed protected evidence, extra removal, wrong original identity, invalid overlay; no count reduction or allow-all fallback.
integrity.outputs: Committed-tree identity reconciliation, exact approved removal counts/sets, original manifest hashes, custody and protected-evidence checks; same successful guard result only on accepted state.
integrity.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
integrity.sequencing: #1350 ports existing guards independently of #1347 completion; adopt new overlays only after preserving original assertions and negative cases.

inventory-tools.failure_cases: Unowned or duplicate paths, invalid manifest, unsupported lane, incorrect revision/case inventory, cycles or stale records; retain deterministic ordering.
inventory-tools.outputs: Revision-bound validation/tool inventories, stable classifications, lane selection and resource guardrails, dependency/owner mappings and reference/audit reports.
inventory-tools.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
inventory-tools.sequencing: Use existing manifest and case identities; resolve private-owner references via accepted owner correspondence, not restored private source.

owner-adapter.caller_switch: #1351 owns owner adapters and groupd subprocess replacement; #1348 owns validation-interface CI contracts.
owner-adapter.failure_cases: Missing/wrong owner artifact, correspondence mismatch, forbidden dependency, failed owner command, unsupported visibility claim.
owner-adapter.outputs: Existing owner-contract invocation and dependency/correspondence/visibility result; unchanged repository ownership and supported adapter output.
owner-adapter.platform_scope: Local owner-contract adapters only; owner platform qualification remains external.
owner-adapter.sequencing: Require accepted owner contract before retiring public adapter; do not copy private code or claim remote product acceptance.

packet-validation.caller_switch: #1351 owns remaining packet validators and supported demo callers; #1346 owns Ruby receipt/denominator helpers.
packet-validation.failure_cases: Missing packet/evidence, invalid hash/revision, absolute or escaping path, unsupported acceptance claim, malformed table/status, referenced artifact mismatch.
packet-validation.outputs: Issue-specific packet/document/report validation results and existing report artifacts; preserve source-declared schema/status/hash/path assertions, tables, denominators and claim boundaries.
packet-validation.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
packet-validation.sequencing: Determine support per actual caller; preserve needed checks, or retire a supported entrypoint only with an explicit disposition. No legacy runtime acceptance inferred from packet consistency.

planning-schema.caller_switch: #1351 owns template/schema utilities; #1348 owns public planning CI check callers.
planning-schema.failure_cases: Missing required sections, invalid types/enums, registry/path escape, schema drift, unsupported lane or unresolved template.
planning-schema.outputs: Versioned template selection, values substitution, section/schema/PVF manifest validation and deterministic rendered documents; unchanged public template bytes.
planning-schema.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
planning-schema.sequencing: Switch schema command consumers after the native equivalent exists; preserve schema interoperability without requiring Python in normal validation.

public-cli.caller_switch: #1349 owns run_cli_ci.sh, associated Rust adapters and coverage harness command switches.
public-cli.failure_cases: Unsupported/private routes, malformed arguments, forged owner responses, missing owner executable, incorrect process/version behavior and unsafe demo output.
public-cli.outputs: Public CLI argument/dispatch/session/refusal behavior, owner lookup, stdout/stderr, exit status and dependency closure: local packages adl, adl-schema, adl-legacy-contracts.
public-cli.platform_scope: Deterministic local Git/filesystem contract; current CI is Ubuntu. Preserve macOS local behavior where invoked; no unrun Windows proof is claimed.
public-cli.sequencing: Preserve CLI command interfaces through #1348. Run native equivalents using actual built binaries, never success-marker substitutes.

public-install.caller_switch: #1349 owns public installer/validator and installed-public-package subprocess replacement.
public-install.failure_cases: UTS schema/resource mismatch, symlinks, altered archive members, dirty producer inputs, leaked home/secrets/network access or dependency on producer checkout.
public-install.outputs: Five Git-blob source distributions, UTS pinned resource reconstruction and provenance, sandboxed consumer proof and package checksum/manifest outputs.
public-install.platform_scope: verify_install.py explicitly enforces macOS sandbox-exec consumer proof; preserve this separately from Linux CI package checks. Do not weaken sandbox to gain portability.
public-install.sequencing: Keep package identifiers/layout/pins and validator entrypoint contract while switching Rust wrappers to real native implementation.
